title: A fetch in flight while the run, its ownership generation, or the recovery epoch ended was still held and returned when it resolved, so obtain, forget, resolve, obtain reused the old credential
resolution: Fetches are registered with run, generation, and epoch; a forget or stale drop ends matching ones, and a late delivery is neither held nor returned but fails with conflict; four controlled-promise tests fail before the fix; design decision 8 and the scenario "Delivery after the end" say so.

title: The slot credential client copied an error answer's message and details.reason into its failure and passed a refusal's message through shape-based sanitizing, which a subscription credential without a fixed shape passes
resolution: A refusal keeps only a listed reason and a local message; any other answer is a failure with its status code, a constant message, and the status only; tests with short arbitrary text in the message, detail values, and an unknown reason fail against the old client.

title: A stale held delivery was dropped only on the next obtain, so without one it stayed in memory, against answer Q7, contract section 7.3, and the scenario "New recovery epoch"
resolution: RunSlotCredentials gains forgetOwnershipGeneration and forgetRecoveryEpoch and renames forget to forgetRun; tests whose later call keeps the same scope fail with no-op operations; port comment, spec delta, design, contract section 13, and proposal follow; the limitation is removed.

title: The delivery service replaced a thrown reveal error but returned any failure other than not-found verbatim, so an adapter diagnostic holding the credential reached the API answer
resolution: Every reveal failure gets a local message naming only the slot, unavailable for a throw or unavailable failure and internal otherwise; a test with thrown and returned failures holding the fixture credential fails before the fix; design decision 3 and contract section 13 say so.

title: No test checked that the delivery record is committed when the reveal runs, that an uncommitted check transaction reveals nothing, or that a failed reveal leaves the record (Q1), and verification.md claimed every new output path was checked
resolution: Three integration tests check the record over another connection inside the reveal, an uncommitted check transaction, and a failed reveal with retry; a mutant revealing inside the transaction fails all three; verification.md lists only the checked output paths.

title: The new persistence port SlotCredentialDeliveries had no shared conformance suite run against both adapters (ADR 0004 principle 2)
resolution: SLOT_CREDENTIAL_DELIVERIES_CONFORMANCE checks lookup by the whole key, replacement, and code point order with isolation, against the in-memory double and PostgreSQL; it rejects three defective doubles, and a defective PostgreSQL adapter fails all three cases.

title: The requirement on transport over TLS only missed the separator before the second item of the client's list, which the pass 1 fix added
resolution: The list now reads "not HTTPS, SHALL use no delivery", the reviewer's wording; the requirement is 401 characters and archives strictly valid.

title: The plain HTTP test claimed the refusal comes before the bearer is read but asserted only that the service was not asked, so a guard moved after authentication passed
resolution: The stub counts calls of authenticateWorkerBearer and the test asserts none on the plain HTTP request; a mutant that moves the TLS guard after authentication fails it.

title: The browser listener served every route, so the confidential slot credential fetch was also answered on the endpoint that may present the operator's certificate, against contract section 7.2
resolution: The browser listener serves no confidential route; an integration test gets 401 on the worker endpoint and 404 on the browser endpoint and fails on the old composition; other worker routes keep their exposure, a follow-up for 12d in the design.

title: Any generation other than the call's counted as stale, so one late call of an older ownership generation dropped the current generation's held credential and failed its fetch in flight
resolution: Only earlier generations are dropped; a call of an older generation than one held or in flight fails with conflict and drops nothing; two tests fail on the old worker; port comment (da5541fe), spec scenario, design, and contract follow.

title: No PostgreSQL test covered an attempt reassigned to another worker at a new ownership generation, after which its old worker fetches again
resolution: An integration case delivers, ends the assignment, releases it, and places the attempt on the other worker at the next generation; both old-worker fetches get assignment-not-active with no reveal or record change; it fails without the ownership checks.

title: The comment on the optional slot credential service read as if the route answers 503 after sub-change 12d wires it
resolution: The comment now says that until 12d wires the key and the admitted pairs the service is absent and the route answers 503, in the reviewer's wording, within the comment length rule.

title: Two revision bullets of the record named commits without their hashes although both commits existed when later bullets were written
resolution: The bullets now cite 8c1a7af9 and feb182e9.

title: The author self-check still said git diff dc2ae98b -- packages/contracts is empty, which the merge 9daa1d65 of dev made untrue
resolution: The self-check cites git diff 3009329f HEAD -- packages/contracts, which is empty, states that 12c itself changes no wire contract, and names the four contract file changes since dc2ae98b as 13b's, inherited from dev.
